description: This file implements an authentication service for a web API, including methods for user registration and login, handling JWT token generation, and user credential validation.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: Handles user registration and login, including JWT issuance and user credential validation.

methods.name: RegisterAsync
methods.description: Registers a new user, ensuring username and email uniqueness, and returns an authentication response including a JWT token.

methods.name: LoginAsync
methods.description: Authenticates a user by username or email and returns an authentication response with a JWT token upon success.

methods.name: GenerateJwtToken
methods.description: Generates a JWT token for a user based on configuration settings and user claims.
